description: 15 hand-written troubleshooting scenarios (from the original CNWT_Problems.txt). The symptom text is phrased freely, NOT taken from the dataset generator's sentence bank, so these test how the system handles wording it has never seen. 'expected' lists the acceptable diagnoses; scenarios marked ambiguous were written to sit between two classes.

scenarios.name: Mixed router failure
scenarios.text: All devices at home suddenly lost internet, WiFi is connected but nothing loads and even router settings page is not opening.

scenarios.name: Subtle DNS issue
scenarios.text: Internet seems fine but every website says it can't be reached unless I use the IP address directly.

scenarios.name: DNS timeout (tricky)
scenarios.text: Web pages take forever to load and sometimes eventually open, but ping to 8.8.8.8 works instantly.

scenarios.name: IP conflict (real-world style)
scenarios.text: My laptop keeps disconnecting randomly and sometimes shows 'another device is using this IP address' warning.

scenarios.name: DHCP failure (edge case)
scenarios.text: My system shows limited connectivity and the IP starts with 169 even after reconnecting multiple times.

scenarios.name: Gateway unreachable
scenarios.text: I checked my IP settings and everything looks fine but I cannot ping my gateway at all.

scenarios.name: Network adapter issue
scenarios.text: My ethernet cable is plugged in but my computer says no network devices found.

scenarios.name: Subnet mismatch
scenarios.text: I manually set an IP but I still can't reach the gateway even though both are in the same range.

scenarios.name: Hybrid: DNS issue vs timeout
scenarios.text: WiFi connects, I get an IP, I can ping the router, but websites are inconsistent and sometimes fail to load.

scenarios.name: Hybrid: router vs gateway
scenarios.text: After changing router settings, none of my devices can access the internet but they all show connected.

scenarios.name: Traceroute dies at first hop
scenarios.text: Traceroute stops at first hop and I cannot reach any external IP, but my device has a valid IP.

scenarios.name: Missing default gateway (OS output)
scenarios.text: ipconfig shows valid IP but default gateway is missing and I get network unreachable errors.

scenarios.name: Real user complaint
scenarios.text: Internet was working fine but suddenly stopped, restarting laptop didn't help, other devices also affected.

scenarios.name: DNS misleading case
scenarios.text: Google sometimes loads but other websites fail, and nslookup gives inconsistent results.

scenarios.name: Adapter vs DHCP confusion
scenarios.text: WiFi connects but shows 'No Internet', and renewing IP doesn't assign anything new.
